text:
Noelle (People Ops): quick thought 92What about a small metal 'kudos token' (pocket coin) people can drop on desks or mail to remote teammates during Recognition Week? tactile + keepsake. low effort to hand out. thoughts? :coin:
Priya (HR Ops): sounds cool. curious about per-unit cost + customs implications for EU/UK. also need policy check for contractors receiving metal goods in some countries.
Jamie (Events): tokens look great. can do two finishes: matte nickel or antique brass. we can laser-etch the Redwood logo on one side and a tiny prompt on the other. vendors: TokenSmith or BrassForge.
Omar (Global Ops): for EU shipments let's avoid vendors that ship from US only. consolidated shipments to SG or NL hub might work. also confirm if tokens trigger import duties in DE/FR.
Ben (Procurement): rough pricing: 500 tokens matte finish ~ $1.90 each = $950 + tooling $120. Antique brass + color fill bumps to ~$3.10 each. Lead time ~ 3-4 weeks once art is approved. I'll ask TokenSmith for EU drop-ship options.
Noelle (People Ops): target audience ~420 people incl contractors. plan for 450 units. Priya, can you check contractor acceptability?
Priya (HR Ops): will check today. small low-value items usually fine but we must record distribution and offer opt-out. will draft a 1-line opt-out in the signup form.
hr-bot: Reminder: Please complete the Gifts & Distribution sheet before ordering. https://drive.company/gifts
Jamie (Events): copy idea for token card sleeve: "Take a token. Give a token. Pass a little thanks." Include QR to post a photo and shoutout in #kudos.
Omar (Global Ops): vendor needs CSV for addresses. Ben, ask for required fields and whether they support multiple ship origins. Also: some APAC countries (PH/ID) may need consolidated freight to SG hub.
Ben (Procurement): vendor requested: ```name,address_line1,address_line2,city,postal,country,email``` I'll confirm multi-origin capability.
Noelle (People Ops): timeline: decide finish by May 24, finalize art May 31, order June 2, distribute June 24-28 (Recognition Week). Can everyone hit that?
Jamie (Events): yes, I'll post two mockups in #design-review by EOD tomorrow.
Priya (HR Ops): I'll finish contractor checks and opt-out wording by May 20.
Omar (Global Ops): mapping distribution: US offices full desk drops, EU direct-ship, APAC consolidated to SG hub. Will gather office address points and hubs.
Ben (Procurement): will get formal quote and PO template by May 17. Expect ~3-4 week production.
Noelle (People Ops): action list: (1) Jamie designs (2) Ben quote + PO (3) Priya compliance + opt-out (4) Omar regional shipping plan + address CSV. I'll create a sign-up sheet for desk drop volunteers and a short RSVP. Anyone else we should cc?
Priya (HR Ops): maybe loop in Legal for any cross-border gift terms.
Jamie (Events): tagging @design for mock approval.
Noelle (People Ops): awesome. if vendor timeline slips we can pivot to printed coin-cards as fallback. thanks team :tada:
